# DS4 performance review — triage

Human-priority action plan distilled from `DS4_REVIEW_PERF.md` (65 findings:
18 high / 34 medium / 13 low), with each headline claim spot-verified against
the source in this tree before ranking.

**Provenance.** Findings generated by `ds4-agent` in the ds4-box sandbox,
performance-focused sweep (`DS4_SWEEP_FOCUS=perf`), `--nothink`. Batches 1-5
ran `laguna-s-2.1-Q4_K_M`; batches 6-8 were re-run on
`Laguna-S-2.1-APEX-i-quality` and produced no findings (see *Coverage gaps*).
Triage and verification by Claude (Opus 4.8) reading the quoted lines here.

**Verification status:** **VERIFIED** (line read, claim correct) ·
**LIKELY** (code matches, full data-flow not traced) · **INFLATED** (code
matches, impact overstated) · **DEAD** (targets code not in the build).

---

## P0 — user-visible, fix first

1. **Adjacency-graph voice assignment runs inside a list-item builder** —
   `lib/features/cast_manager/cast_manager_screen.dart:366` (VERIFIED: the call
   sits inside `Widget _buildCharacterCard(...)`) and
   `lib/features/cast_manager/voice_config_screen.dart:143` (same shape).
   `VoiceConfigService.assignVoicesFromScript()` walks every script line and
   builds the full adjacency graph, and it is invoked **once per character
   card, on every rebuild**. With N characters that is N full passes over the
   script per frame-ish rebuild. Fix: hoist the call to the screen's state
   (compute once per script/preset change, e.g. in `_loadVoiceConfig` or a
   memoised provider) and pass the resulting map into the card builder.
   *Note this is the same call site as the correctness bug in
   `DS4_REVIEW_TRIAGE.md` item 10 (missing `genderOverrides`) — fix both in one
   edit.*

2. **`cacheExtent: 10000` on the rehearsal script list** —
   `lib/features/rehearsal/rehearsal_screen.dart:874` (VERIFIED, with a comment
   explaining the intent: keeping `_currentLineKey` available for scrolling).
   That forces Flutter to build and retain roughly 145 offscreen rows, which is
   memory and build cost on every rehearsal screen, on the lowest-end device
   the app targets. The intent is legitimate; the mechanism is expensive.
   Fix: drop `cacheExtent` to a small multiple of the viewport and drive
   scrolling with `scrollToIndex`-style index math (or
   `ScrollablePositionedList`) instead of relying on the widget already being
   built.

3. **Recursive directory scan on the recordings path fallback** —
   `lib/features/recording_studio/recordings_browser_screen.dart:596-608`
   (VERIFIED: `.listSync(recursive: true)` on the cache directory).
   Synchronous, recursive, on the UI isolate, in a *fallback* path that runs
   per unresolved recording — so a browser with many unresolved rows walks the
   cache tree repeatedly and janks. Fix: build the file index once
   (`listSync` → `Map<id, path>`) before rendering, or move the walk to
   `compute()`/an isolate and cache the result.

## P1 — real inefficiency, not yet user-visible

4. **O(n²) dedup when restoring the sync queue** —
   `lib/data/services/sync_queue.dart:222-225` (VERIFIED: `_pending.any(...)`
   and `_failed.any(...)` inside `for (final job in restored)`). Fine at
   today's queue sizes, quadratic as they grow, and it runs at startup. Fix:
   build a `Set` of `'$productionId/$lineId'` keys once, then membership-test.

5. **Per-sample `Data` allocation in the WAV writer** —
   `ios/Runner/KokoroMLXService.swift:268` (VERIFIED: `data.append(Data(bytes:
   &int16, count: 2))` inside `for sample in buffer`). One heap allocation per
   audio sample — ~120k allocations for a 5-second 24 kHz clip, on the TTS
   path. Fix: reserve capacity and append into a single `Data`/`[Int16]`
   buffer, then one `Data(bytes:)` at the end. **This is the live vendored copy
   under `ios/Runner/`, unlike the `LocalPackages` twins below.**

6. **`stripDiacritics` splits every string into a character list** —
   `lib/data/services/ocr_confidence_service.dart:163-169` (VERIFIED:
   `s.split('')` allocates a `List<String>` of every character). Called from
   `_isValidWord` (`:176`) for **every word of every OCR'd line**, and that
   method also calls into the spell-checker per word. On a full script import
   this is the OCR hot loop. Fix: iterate `codeUnits`/`runes` without
   materialising a list, keep the `StringBuffer`, and memoise `_isValidWord`
   per distinct word (scripts repeat vocabulary heavily).

7. **`linesInScene(scene)` computed twice per scene row** —
   `lib/features/production_hub/production_hub_screen.dart:401-411` (VERIFIED:
   two separate calls in the same `itemBuilder`). Fix: assign to a local at the
   top of the builder. Trivial, and it halves the work.

8. **Positional-only script diff** —
   `lib/features/script_editor/cloud_sync_dialog.dart:22-44` (LIKELY). A
   sequential index-to-index comparison means a single inserted line makes
   every subsequent line look changed — both a performance and a *correctness*
   smell in the sync dialog. Fix: key the diff on line id, or use a proper LCS.

9. **`_syncCastFromCloud` nested membership scan** —
   `lib/features/cast_manager/cast_manager_screen.dart:86-99` (LIKELY:
   `cloudMembers.any(...)` per local member). Same `Set`-index fix as item 4;
   small cast lists today, so lower priority.

## P2 — vendored ML code (live copies only)

The `parakeet-stt` STT path carries the genuinely expensive patterns, already
triaged in `DS4_REVIEW_TRIAGE.md` (P-1..P-4) and unchanged here:
per-frame `eval(jointOut)` device round-trips in `decodeTDT`/`decodeRNNT`
(`ParakeetModel.swift:263,347`), the recomputed mel filterbank
(`DSP.swift:76,250`), and the O(n·m) overlap matcher
(`ParakeetAlignment.swift:144`). Fix opportunistically when touching STT.

`ios/Runner/KokoroVendored/**` findings (LSTM `insert(at: 0)` per timestep,
`createAlignmentTarget` calling `.item()` per phoneme) are real and on the live
TTS path — worth fixing when that code is next touched, since both are
quadratic-or-worse in sequence length.

## DEAD — do not spend time here

Roughly a third of the report targets **`ios/LocalPackages/kokoro-ios/`**,
which is **not in the build**: `Runner.xcodeproj` references only
`parakeet-stt`, nothing imports `KokoroSwift`, and the live engine is the
vendored copy under `ios/Runner/KokoroVendored/`. Every finding whose path
starts `ios/LocalPackages/kokoro-ios/` — the LSTM `insert(at: 0)`,
`createAlignmentTarget`, `AudioUtils` per-sample copies, `AdaINResBlock1`
axis swaps, `Generator` per-iteration `LeakyReLU` construction — is duplicated
against dead code. **Deleting that package (see `DS4_REVIEW_TRIAGE.md` item 9)
removes them all and prevents the next review from re-finding them.**

## Coverage gaps — this report is incomplete

Batches 6, 7 and 8 (101 files: `lib/features/**` screens and providers,
`supabase/migrations/**`, `test/**`, `tool/**`) produced **no findings file**.
All three agent runs entered the same loop — doubting that the listed paths
belonged to this project, re-reading files (arm A: 577 reads for 53 files) and
never writing output. The harness correctly refused to mark them complete, so
they will be retried.

Practically: **the perf review of the screens/providers layer is missing**, and
several P0 items above came from batches 1-5 only. Re-run before treating this
as a complete performance pass:

```sh
DS4_SWEEP=1 DS4_SWEEP_FOCUS=perf DS4_MODEL=APEX DS4_CTX=262144 \
    ds4-box ~/experiments/CastCircle      # completed batches skip automatically
```

A working-directory assertion was added to the batch prompt
(`ds4_analyze` commit `8f5e649`) to address the specific confusion; whether it
resolves it is still being measured.

## Suggested order

Items 2 and 7 are minutes of work. Item 1 is the biggest real win and shares an
edit with a known correctness bug. Item 3 is the one most likely to be felt as
jank on a real device. Then the `Set`-index cleanups (4, 9), then item 6 if
script import feels slow. Delete the dead package before the next review so its
noise stops recurring.
